$comment: Promotional campaign definitions seeded into Firestore by scripts/promo/seed-promo-campaign.mjs.
This file is the reviewable grant POLICY (which tier, how long, how many, which window).
Firestore is the runtime source of truth: pausing, capping, or rotating a live campaign is a
seed-script run, not a deploy. See docs/PROMO_CAMPAIGNS.md.
defaultCode is the code printed in the launch post — public marketing copy, not a secret.
Only its SHA-256 digest is ever written to Firestore. Rotate with --code <NEW> at seed time;
the campaign document and every grant it already made are untouched by a rotation.
